notes.title: Renewed design!
notes.content: [list][*][p]The protagonist’s illustration in the episode [i]“Prologue”[/i] has been improved.[/p][/*][/list][p]At first, I used artwork from an illustrator I admire as a reference, and since its creation I tried to do it in my own way. But now that I’ve gained more experience, I decided to make changes in order to complete something truly unique to myself.[/p][p]From the time I created even the Light Novel [i]“Reset”[/i], I’ve learned a lot, so from time to time, I may make improvements to the other designs as well.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, she was only 16 years old at this point in the story. Sutelz had not yet met her friend Orion, who appears in the JRPG, so the brooch added to her outfit was meant to express change. At that moment, she was searching for something that would give her more confidence when being around others.[/p][p][i]The hope of a new life...[/i][/p][p][/p][p]With this, the “emptiness” that was once there has now faded. The drawing has come to life.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Detail:[/b] This outfit is something she received from Henry so she could protect herself during the coldest time of the year.[/p][p][/p][p]I hope you like it, and that better days will come for Sutelz![/p][p][/p][p][b]Before[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508334/2f882cd60dd581303f1a77bc4988a9452be0917d.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]After[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44508334/df8f41668148ef16bac6416cf3194ead62b92ab5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: "Kimi sae Ireba", English-language edition is now available!
notes.content:
Modifications:

- Full English translation.
- New filter.
- Compressed files, making the game lighter. (Before(1.3GB) > After(433MB)

[h1]Main details of the update:[/h1]

"Kimi sae Ireba" has already been released on Steam in 2 different languages (Japanese and Portuguese - Brazil), and will soon have another RPG version!

Previously it was only the interface, but now the game is available with full English support, so that as many people as possible can play and get to know the world of "Kimi sae Ireba".

Take the opportunity to buy it and begin to understand the planet "Ser****", which will be shown a little more in depth in the near future in the RPG that will tell the past of the protagonist "Sutelz Selz"!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2534630/Kimi_sae_Ireba/

Translation by: Douglas Almeida - designdouglas
